trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: When the final cutscene fades and the credits finish rolling, this is the trophy the whole book has been walking toward. It cannot be chased directly: it arrives on its own once every other scene, errand and detour in Leonida is complete. Read the story first, sweep the off-script index last, and let the legend price itself.
steps: Earn every other trophy on the list
Let the story trophies land in chapter order
Sweep the off-script index last
trophies.beatText: The credits have rolled and Leonida is still standing. This is the moment the whole run has been walking toward, when the pair stop being fugitives in someone else's story and become the legend the platinum is named for.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The game opens on the water, and Gone Fishing teaches you its language while pretending to be a day off. Stay in the scene: follow the prompts as they come, take the quiet casting moments slowly, and do not go exploring yet. Right after the closing cutscene of the trip, the trophy lands.
steps: Start a new game and play Gone Fishing
Follow the on-screen prompts to learn the controls
Finish the mission to earn the trophy
trophies.beatText: The story opens on the water, all heat and stillness, before Vice City pulls the pair back in. It is the calm first page of the book: a fishing trip that quietly introduces the two people you will spend the whole game protecting.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Chapter 1 plays like the last week of a holiday you cannot afford to extend. Nothing here needs preparation: follow the mission markers as the pair settle back into the city, and let each scene hand you to the next. The moment the chapter's final cutscene ends, the trophy is yours.
steps: Play the main missions in order
Learn the city layout as you go
Finish the last mission of Chapter 1
trophies.beatText: By the end of Chapter 1 the holiday is over. A door that looked open quietly locks behind the pair, and paradise starts charging rent — the story's first real turn from freedom into consequence.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: As Chapter 2 opens, the money starts moving and the missions grow teeth. Make a manual save on the chapter break — later pages of this book will thank you — then play the main thread straight through. When the closing scene of the chapter cuts to black, the trophy follows it.
steps: Make a manual save at the chapter start
Play the main missions in order
Finish the last mission of Chapter 2
trophies.beatText: Chapter 2 smells of fast cash and bad company. The pair stop surviving and start earning, and every dollar in this chapter comes with a name attached — names that will matter much later.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Midway through the book the city finally opens at full volume, neon and all. Between the big scenes of Chapter 3 there is room to breathe — a few off-script errands fit naturally in the gaps — but nothing here can be lost for good. Play to the chapter finale and the trophy arrives with it.
steps: Play the main missions in order
Explore the newly opened districts
Finish the last mission of Chapter 3
trophies.beatText: This is the chapter the trailers promised: neon, noise and the city at full volume. Underneath the celebration the net is tightening, and the pair are having too much fun to notice it yet.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Chapter 4 is the climb, and its late scenes hit harder than anything before them. Before the final run of missions, stop at an Ammu-Nation, top up armour, and keep your partner in sight when the game splits the pair up. Survive the chapter's last scene and the trophy lands on the cut.
steps: Restock ammo and armour before late missions
Play the main missions in order
Finish the last mission of Chapter 4
trophies.beatText: For one bright moment the pair can see the whole state from where they stand. Chapter 4 lets them enjoy the view — and lets the reader feel exactly how far there is left to fall.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The last page of the story asks everything the game has taught you, all at once. Walk into the final mission with full health, full armour and your best weapons already in hand, and do not rush the closing sequences — let them play. The gold lands as the mission ends.
steps: Prepare with full health and armour
Play the final mission to its end
Watch the closing scenes for the trophy
trophies.beatText: Every road in Leonida has been leading to this one drive. The final mission asks the only question the whole story has really been asking: when the ride ends, who is still sitting beside you?

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Right after the prologue's quiet opening, this small morning errand shows you how the pair move as one. Lucia sets the pace here: keep the drive clean, stay on her line through traffic, and resist the urge to improvise. The scene closes gently, and the trophy closes with it.
steps: Accept the Breakfast Run mission
Stay close to your partner throughout
Finish the errand to earn the trophy
trophies.beatText: A small morning errand, the kind couples run a thousand times. In the middle of it the game quietly states its thesis: these two trust each other with the ordinary things, which is why the extraordinary things will hurt.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Halfway through Chapter 2 the book turns into a heist film. At the planning board, read every approach before choosing — the loud entry is shorter but the escape runs hotter — and once the alarm sounds, keep moving and never double back for dropped cash. Any route through the heist earns the trophy when you clear the area.
steps: Complete the heist preparation tasks
Run The Cartel Heist from start to finish
Escape the area to close the mission
trophies.beatText: The first time the pair stop stealing to survive and start stealing to win. The Cartel Heist is loud, greedy and joyful — and it puts their faces in front of exactly the wrong people.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: This Chapter 1 scene slows the book down on purpose, and Lucia carries it. There is no gunfight to prepare for: sit in the conversations, let the kid set the tempo, and play the small moments instead of skipping them. When the scene lets go of you, the trophy has already landed.
steps: Start the Child's Play mission
Follow the story beats to the end
Finish the mission to earn the trophy
trophies.beatText: A mission about family, played at walking pace. Child's Play shows you what the pair are actually fighting to keep — a home, a kid's laughter, a life that does not need sirens in it.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: By this point in Chapter 3 the pair are famous whether they like it or not, and Headliners plays that fame loud. Stay glued to the objective markers when the crowd chaos starts — side fights here only burn time and health — and save your sprint for the set-piece finish. Reach the final cutscene and the trophy is yours.
steps: Start the Headliners mission
Stick to the objective markers
Finish the closing set piece
trophies.beatText: Fame arrives in Chapter 3 whether the pair want it or not. Headliners turns their faces into headlines, and after this mission there is nowhere in Leonida left to be anonymous.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Late in Chapter 4 the story takes the airport by force. Move hangar to hangar in cover, watch the flanks when the resistance thickens near the end, and hold your heaviest weapons for the final push across open ground. However you carve the route, finishing the takedown earns the trophy.
steps: Start the VCIA Takedown mission
Push through the airport in cover
Finish the takedown to earn the trophy
trophies.beatText: The airport job is where Chapter 4 stops being a climb and becomes a war. VCIA Takedown is the pair announcing, at maximum volume, that they are done running from anyone.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: This is Chapter 4 at its ugliest: a long operation in several waves with a vehicle section buried in the middle. Before it starts, fill your armour and put snacks on the quick menu; during it, never stray far from your partner for long. Outlast the final wave and the trophy lands with the silence after.
steps: Start Operation Savage Glory fully stocked
Hold position through the waves
Finish the mission to earn the trophy
trophies.beatText: A storm with no snow in it — just money, powder and gunfire. Savage Glory is the ugliest job of Chapter 4, and the one that makes the final chapter's choices feel inevitable.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Save this for the very end of the book, when the credits have rolled and Leonida is yours to wander. The completion list in the pause menu is the real text here: work it one category at a time — a stranger strand tonight, a collectible sweep tomorrow — instead of chasing the number. This gold usually falls pages after the story is over.
steps: Finish the story and all stranger strands
Clear every activity and collectible category
Check the completion list until it reads 100%

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Between chapters, when the story gives you an evening off, this is how to spend it. Take a fast, durable car and clear stunt jumps district by district, the way you'd read a map with your fingers. A failed landing costs nothing but ten seconds — turn around and take the jump again while the line is still fresh in your hands.
steps: Find a stunt jump and clear it cleanly
Work through one district at a time
Repeat until 250 stunts are complete

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Early in the run, when every icon on the map is still a rumour, spend one session as a tourist. Open the map filters, visit one marker of each activity type, and play each only until it registers — a single race, a single round, a single cast of the line. It is the fastest bronze in the book.
steps: Open the map and note each activity type
Play one session of every type
Check the list until all types register

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Duck into the range on the quiet days between story beats, when nobody is shooting back. Each weapon class keeps its own rhythm, so learn one board at a time: run it slow, memorise the target order, then run it for gold. Accuracy bonuses beat raw speed on most boards — breathe before you squeeze.
steps: Enter the Shooting Range and pick a challenge
Memorise the target order in practice
Earn gold on every challenge board

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: These little drone races hide in the city's tightest gaps, the places the story drives straight past. Fly each course once at sightseeing speed so the gates stop surprising you, then attack it on the second run. You only need first place, not a clean sheet — clipped corners still count at the line.
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race start point
Scout the course with one practice run
Win the race at every location

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Start these on the nights the story leaves you in the city with a full tank. Variety matters more than mastery: each distinct event only counts once, so keep moving to fresh start lines instead of defending a favourite. Begin with the short street sprints and save the long point-to-points for when your car has grown teeth.
steps: Enter any street race and win a new event each time
Move to a new event each time
Repeat until 20 different races are won

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: On a slow Chapter 1 afternoon, Jason ends up on a dock with Cal and his endless opinions about fish. Watch the water more than the man: strike on the strong bites, ignore the ripples he tries to bait you with, and keep the line tension steady while a fish runs. Out-catch him once and the scene — and the trophy — are yours.
steps: Meet Cal at the fishing spot
Enter his fishing challenge
Catch more than Cal before time runs out
trophies.beatText: An old fisherman, a quiet dock and a wager neither side takes seriously. This small Chapter 1 contest is the story breathing — proof the pair can still enjoy an afternoon that asks nothing of them.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Somewhere between story beats you'll walk past an arcade cabinet glowing in a bar or a boardwalk. Stop. Pick the shortest game on the machine, learn its one pattern, and play it to its actual end screen — a high score is not a finish. Five minutes later you're back in the story with a bronze in your pocket.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet in the city
Choose the shortest game available
Play it through to completion

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's favours pepper Chapter 2 like interruptions, and Jason keeps answering the phone. Work his markers as they appear between the big scenes rather than saving them up, because his final mission assumes you remember the messes that built it. When his last job closes, the trophy closes the strand with it.
steps: Complete Andy's missions as they appear
Start his final mission when offered
Finish it to earn the trophy
trophies.beatText: Andy keeps insisting he is turning his life around, usually while asking for something illegal. His final mission in Chapter 2 is the story asking whether anyone in this city actually gets to change.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's strand pulls Jason out onto the water again and again through Chapter 3, and each errand is longer than the last. Keep the boat in one piece between jobs if the game lets you, and bring patience for his final run — it is the strand's biggest scene by far. Finish it, and the trophy surfaces with the wreckage.
steps: Complete Kenton's missions as they appear
Start his final mission when offered
Finish it to earn the trophy
trophies.beatText: Kenton swears the sea is safer than the streets, right up until it is not. His final mission closes Chapter 3's loudest friendship with salt water, wreckage and a very Kenton kind of denial.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's jobs are long rides through Chapter 4 with Jason riding shotgun on another man's loneliness. Stay in formation, keep Billy's vehicle intact when trouble finds the convoy, and his final mission becomes a straight road home. Finish that last ride beside him and the trophy is yours.
steps: Complete Billy's missions as they appear
Start his final mission when offered
Finish the last ride to earn the trophy
trophies.beatText: Billy never asks for help, which is exactly why his final mission matters. In Chapter 4 the lone rider finally lets someone ride beside him, and the story treats that as the victory it is.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Leonida keeps introducing you to people mid-crisis, usually at the exact moment you had other plans. Say yes anyway. Each strand is a short story of its own — finish every job that person offers until their marker disappears for good, then let the next stranger find you. Eight closed strands earn this silver.
steps: Meet a stranger and finish their first job
Return until their strand is complete
Repeat until 8 strands are finished

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: In the final chapter even the side hustles turn into runs for your life, and Lucia drives Randy's last delivery. Protect the cargo the way the strand taught you — steady on the straights, ruthless at the chokepoints — and do not stop for anything the road throws at you. Deliver it, and the trophy signs the receipt.
steps: Complete Randy's missions as they appear
Start his final mission when offered
Deliver the final job to earn the trophy
trophies.beatText: In the final chapter even the side hustles turn serious. Randy's last delivery runs through a state that is actively hunting the pair, and finishing it feels less like business and more like loyalty.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone has been promising Jason a legendary night all game, and his final mission in the last chapter is that promise coming due. Play along with the spectacle, keep up when he improvises — he will — and protect the gig when it tips sideways near the end. Close his strand and the trophy takes a bow with him.
steps: Complete Tyrone's missions as they appear
Start his final mission when offered
Finish the showpiece to earn the trophy
trophies.beatText: Tyrone always said he would go out with a bang, and his final mission in the last chapter makes good on it. It is the story's loudest goodbye, played at full volume on purpose.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: After the loud chapters, the map offers you these quiet corners — hilltops, beaches, overlooks where the sirens can't reach. Travel to each one, sit down, and stay until the meditation completes instead of cancelling out early. Clear them region by region, the way the story clears its own head between storms.
steps: Find a meditation spot in the wild
Meditate until the session completes
Repeat at every spot across Leonida

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret talks about one animal the way other men talk about weather — constantly, and as if it personally offended him. Follow his directions into its territory, slow down before the ground tells you to, and take the shot only when it presents itself cleanly. Carry the hunt home to Bret to close the scene.
steps: Take the hunting job from Bret
Track the unique animal in its territory
Complete the hunt and return to Bret

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: The cards turn up where Leonida lingers — bars, back rooms, shop counters the story only glances at. Pick one set and hunt it like a subplot: check interiors properly, look behind counters, finish the set before starting another. Three completed decks earn the silver.
steps: Pick up a collectible card in the world
Finish one full set card by card
Repeat until 3 sets are complete

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: You'll start noticing WAiNK spots the way you notice your own name in conversation — everywhere, once you're listening. Don't plan special trips: they cluster in the busy districts you cross between story beats anyway. Tag each one as you pass and let the counter climb quietly in the background of the run.
steps: Find a WAiNK location marker
Use the WAiNK interaction there
Repeat at 100 different locations

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Challenges are the game's small talk — short trials scattered across the map between the big conversations. A bronze finish still counts as a conversation had, so don't restart for gold unless a trial genuinely charms you. Fifty of them, swept up alongside your other errands, close this one out.
steps: Start any challenge on the map
Finish it at any medal level
Repeat until 50 challenges are complete

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: When a Chapter 3 job leaves you both lit up at four stars, don't split up to shake it — that's the whole point of the scene. Dive for a tunnel, an alley or the water together the second the search begins, stay out of the sight cones, and breathe until the stars drain. You both walk out free, or neither of you does.
steps: Raise a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner present
Break line of sight and hide
Escape until the wanted level clears
trophies.beatText: Four stars, one car, two people who refuse to split up. This Chapter 3 escape is the partnership in miniature: the heat is never really about the police, it is about whether they run together.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Pick a district where the shops huddle close together, because this scene is one continuous take. Rob the first till, walk straight into the next shop while the heat is still breathing down your neck, and keep your partner at your shoulder the whole time. The chain — and the trophy — breaks if the wanted level dies between shops.
steps: Find three shops close together
Rob them one after another with your partner
Keep the Wanted Level alive until the third is done

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Treat every new car on the road as a sentence you haven't read yet. The story will hand you most of this list on its own, so help it along: swap seats whenever an unfamiliar model rolls past, and cruise the rich districts and the docks when you want the rare metal. A hundred first drives arrive sooner than the number suggests.
steps: Enter and drive a vehicle you have not used
Swap cars whenever a new model appears
Repeat until 100 vehicles are discovered

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Wait for a scene that crowds enemies into the open — a yard, a lot, a roadblock — before you spend your Focus. Line the shots up in your head while time still runs normally, trigger the slowdown, then work left to right without second-guessing. Five clean takedowns inside one breath of slowed time is the whole trick.
steps: Gather at least five enemies in one fight
Activate Combat Focus with targets in view
Take down 5 enemies before it ends

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Inside the VCIA sequence there is a blink-and-miss-it moment where the airport offers you an exit the script never scheduled. Save manually before the airport section begins so the attempt costs nothing, keep your eyes open while the scene unfolds, and the instant the unofficial way out appears — take it, don't admire it.
steps: Save manually before the VCIA section
Watch for the unscheduled exit window
Leave VCIA by the unofficial route
trophies.missableReason: The unscheduled departure only exists inside the VCIA story sequence; once the mission moves past the airport, the window closes for the rest of the playthrough.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Sooner or later the state's answer to everything arrives on treads. When a Rhino rolls into your scene, don't duel it in the open like the cutscene wants you to — drag it somewhere with stairs, pillars and tight interiors it can't follow. From real cover, heavy explosives turn the monster into a negotiation you can win.
steps: Provoke or find a Rhino tank
Fight it from cover with explosives
Survive the encounter to earn the trophy

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Play this one like the quiet scene in a loud film. Case the store first — staff positions, camera arcs, the door nobody watches — then move slowly, keep your silhouette boring, and leave by the least observed exit before anyone's voice rises. If you're spotted, reload and study exactly which glance gave you away.
steps: Choose a jewelry store and watch its routine
Rob it while staying undetected
Leave before any alarm is raised

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Vault jobs are the story's set pieces you schedule yourself. Before the drill ever spins, park the escape car facing out and walk your exit route once on foot. Inside, the timer will beg you to get greedy — leave when the plan says leave. Five clean getaways, five chapters of your own little crime novel.
steps: Rob a bank vault and take its contents
Escape until the heat clears
Repeat until 5 vaults are robbed

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: The trucks run their routes like minor characters with somewhere to be. Set your scene ahead of one: block it hard with a heavy vehicle, deal with the guards before the conversation turns into a siege, and crack it open fast. Then vanish — break line of sight early and keep moving until the escape registers.
steps: Find and stop an armored truck
Open it and take the cash
Escape until the heat clears

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Leave this for the epilogue, when the story stops telling you where to drive. The grey patches left on the map are almost always water, islands and back roads the plot never needed. Take a helicopter at dawn and sweep them methodically, county by county, until the whole state has been seen with your own eyes.
steps: Open the map and find unexplored areas
Visit every district and island
Sweep the last grey patches by air

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Read the map like a cast list: every gang colours its turf, and every gang keeps one illegal operation running on it. Rob one, then leave that crew alone and go introduce yourself to the next — farming the same gang teaches the counter nothing. Nine introductions later, the state runs noticeably quieter.
steps: Find an illegal operation on gang turf
Rob it and get away
Repeat for an operation of each gang

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: In the opening hours, when the story first sets you down on Ocean Beach, it offers you a drink with a view and then immediately tries to hurry you along. Refuse the hurry. Find the cocktail spot while the light is still doing its trick, take the prompt, and let the scene breathe — this exact moment never comes back once the prologue closes.
steps: Save manually when you first reach Ocean Beach
Find the cocktail spot with the view
Take the drink before moving the story on
trophies.missableReason: The Ocean Beach cocktail moment only exists during the opening stretch of the story; after the prologue closes, the spot and its prompt are gone for the rest of the playthrough.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Every car film has this scene; Leonida just lets you shoot it yourself. Walk into a showroom with a big glass front, take a car off its little stage, and leave through the window instead of the door — build enough speed that the exit reads as a statement, not a parking error. The trophy pops as you land outside.
steps: Enter a vehicle showroom
Get into a car inside the showroom
Drive out through the glass front

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Between the loud chapters, the Kolt and Associates alley offers the most ordinary evening in the state — and hides a small extra moment around the lanes. Play a frame, stay for the follow-through prompt when it surfaces, and take it instead of heading straight back to the car. The trophy rolls in behind it.
steps: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley
Play a game of bowling there
Take the follow-through prompt when offered

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Once, in the middle chapters, the story puts the pair's teamwork on public display and watches what they do with an audience. Keep a manual save before the big partner set pieces so the moment costs you nothing to retry. When the crowd-facing scene arrives, play it as a duet — the trophy only recognises the version where neither of them performs alone.
steps: Save manually before partner set pieces
Play the partnership moment as a duo
Finish the scene together to earn the trophy
trophies.missableReason: The partnership moment is a one-time story scene; if the pair are split or the scene is rushed past, the shared version of it never repeats in this playthrough.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The story keeps receipts. At its branching moments it tracks not just what you chose but whether you stayed chosen, so save before the big mid-game decisions, pick like you mean it, and live with the consequences on screen. Reloading around the choices to shop for better outcomes leaves the tracker short of what this trophy needs.
steps: Save manually before major story choices
Commit to each choice when it is offered
Finish the sequence without reloading past it
trophies.missableReason: The choice tracker only fills from decisions made inside this playthrough's story beats; once a branching chapter closes, its choices cannot be re-made without starting the chapter over.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Somewhere out there is an attempt the game has rigged for you to fail, beautifully, the first time. When it collapses, resist the oldest instinct in gaming — do not reload an earlier save. Take the second chance the scene itself offers you, on the spot, with the embarrassment still warm. Succeeding on that immediate retry is the entire scene.
steps: Reach the scripted first attempt
Let the first try fail as designed
Succeed on the immediate second try
trophies.missableReason: The second-chance sequence only triggers immediately after the designed first failure; reloading an earlier save or skipping the retry removes the sequence from this playthrough.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Wait for a night when the story is between storms, then drive out past where the city lights give up — the swamps, the far fields, the roads with no names in the dialogue. Investigate anything that doesn't behave like scenery. When something genuinely strange starts, don't drive off: stay in the scene until it finishes being strange.
steps: Head out of the city at night
Explore the swamps and remote areas
Witness a strange event to its end

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Find a busy pavement and treat it like a bowling lane with worse lighting. Roll past slowly — speed is the enemy of aim here — and swing from the driver's seat as your target crosses the front fender. One clean knockdown, scored like a strike, is all the scene asks for.
steps: Drive slowly past a crowded pavement
Perform a melee swing from the vehicle
Knock a pedestrian down with the drive-by

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Every robbery scene ends the same way: a bag of bills too hot to spend. Don't sit on them — walk them straight to your laundering contacts while the money's story is still simple, and let the dime-on-the-dollar rate sting a little less each time. Across a full run of heists and hold-ups, the washed total climbs to a quarter of a million.
steps: Collect marked bills from robberies
Launder them through your contacts
Repeat until $250,000 has been laundered

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: This counter is the run's quiet montage: every weapon bought before a big scene, every outfit, every haircut between chapters adds a frame. Don't hoard cash out of habit — the story's later pages demand the gear anyway. A hundred thousand spent across a full playthrough happens almost without a decision ever being made.
steps: Buy gear and services in any shop
Keep spending as the story opens new stores
Reach $100,000 total spent

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Garages go on sale across the state like little epilogues with price tags. Buy the cheap ones early, when the story's money is small, and save the prime Vice City boxes for the morning after a heist, when it isn't. The trophy signs the deed on the final purchase.
steps: Earn cash through jobs and robberies
Buy each garage property on the map
Purchase the last garage to earn the trophy

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Every time a car earns a place in the story — the getaway wheels, the beach-day convertible, the one that survived the finale — register it in the Scooter Bros app before the moment passes. Ten registrations collected car by car across the run beats grinding ten junkers in a car park at the end, and it reads better too.
steps: Acquire a vehicle you want to keep
Register it in the Scooter Bros app
Repeat until 10 vehicles are registered
